title: Reservations Desk Card: Work-Charge Set-Off on Made-to-Order Remakes (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** On a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order remake, the work charge kept on the cancelled pair is set off against the remake deposit. The work charge kept is the amount-kept entry on the pair's history, its forfeited deposit entry. The share set off depends on when the remake is taken:

| Remake taken, days after the date the customer asked to cancel the pair | Share of the work charge kept that is set off |
|---|---|
| Within 14 days | 40 percent |
| From 15 days up to 30 days | 20 percent |
| Later than 30 days | 0 percent |

The date the customer asked to cancel is the date of the most recent cancellation request on the pair. Days are calendar days from that date to the day the remake is taken. The set-off is subtracted from the amount that the remake deposit percentage gives on the price, before the floor on the remake deposit applies.

**Edges**

| Days | Share set off |
|---|---|
| 14 | 40 percent |
| 15 | 20 percent |
| 30 | 20 percent |
| 31 | 0 percent |

**Desk example (hypothetical).** The work charge kept on the cancelled pair was $150.00, and the remake is taken 9 days after the customer's most recent cancellation request. The set-off is 40 percent of $150.00, which is $60.00. It comes off the amount the remake deposit percentage gives on the price.
